scenarios.input: User says only discuss a feature; no approved plan.
scenarios.expected: No product writes; prepare a concrete plan and await explicit approval.

scenarios.input: Approved plan is frozen; a worker wants to edit its scope.
scenarios.expected: Stop affected work and return to planning; approval becomes stale.

scenarios.input: Quick fix grows to three files and changes a flag contract.
scenarios.expected: Return to feature planning before further writes.

scenarios.input: An implementation task passed; external executor requests a commit and branch cleanup.
scenarios.expected: Return task evidence to controller; no commit, cleanup or finishing.

scenarios.input: Checked task one is unchanged, task two is incomplete.
scenarios.expected: Reuse valid task one and dispatch only remaining task two.

scenarios.input: A file changes after final review but before ship.
scenarios.expected: Invalidate readiness and final approval; recheck and review changed candidate.
Report blocked readiness; never substitute self-review.

scenarios.input: Worker says all checks passed without commands/output.
scenarios.expected: Treat result as unverified claim; collect actual evidence.

scenarios.input: Direct Flow request without Spec or its binary.
scenarios.expected: Report missing artifact capability; do not install or invent commands.

scenarios.input: Worker receives exact read and write scopes.
scenarios.expected: Return TaskResult; do not invoke root router or change state.
